user_message: A 10 μF capacitor charges through a 100 kΩ resistor from an ideal 5 V source. About how long until it reaches 95% of its final voltage, and what assumptions enter that estimate?
allowed_evidence: For an ideal RC charging circuit, V(t)=V₀(1−e^(−t/RC)). Reaching 95% means e^(−t/RC)=0.05, and −ln(0.05)≈3.0.
public_rubric: Calculates the time and units correctly.
